dek: Forty-four convictions were recorded in July 2026 for breaches of legislation enforced by the Environmental Protection Department. Eight of the convictions were under the Air Pollution Control Ordinance, three were under the Noise Control Ordinance, 15 were under the Public Cleansing and Prevention of Nuisances Regulat
